name: mt-bench-pt-br
description: mt-bench-pt-br is a Portuguese-language version of the MT-Bench evaluation suite, intended to assess LLMs' instruction-following, reasoning, and response quality in Brazilian Portuguese. It contains translated prompts and tasks from MT-Bench to measure model helpfulness, factuality, and alignment in Portuguese-speaking contexts using open-ended responses and comparative judgments.
reputation: A community-driven translation/adaptation of MT-Bench for Portuguese; useful for Portuguese evaluations but not as widely adopted as the original English benchmarks.
